title: A Reply from Lisa
text:
Hi Tom, thanks for your email! I was happy to hear from you. Sorry I am late with my reply. I was very busy this week.

Next Saturday I am free in the morning. Let's meet at the café near the park at ten o'clock. Can you come? Write back soon. See you, Lisa.

options: She is late with her reply

questions.text: When does Lisa want to meet Tom?
What kind of email is this?
options: A formal letter to a company

questions.text: What does Lisa most likely want Tom to do?

vocabulary.definition: after the time that was planned
having a lot of things to do
not working or doing anything else at a certain time
to see someone at a planned time and place

paragraph_translations: ¡Hola Tom, gracias por tu correo! Me alegró mucho saber de ti. Perdona que llegue tarde con mi respuesta. Estuve muy ocupada esta semana.
El próximo sábado estoy libre por la mañana. Quedemos en la cafetería cerca del parque a las diez. ¿Puedes venir? Escríbeme pronto. Hasta luego, Lisa.
